spec.name: Halloween Green Wrapped Sweet
spec.description: An original Orange SMP Halloween sweet with a plump purple centre, lime-green folded shoulders and pointed, stepped twist wrappers. Fifteen axis-aligned cuboids preserve a crisp inventory silhouette and transparent negative space within x0–16, y4–12, z4–12.

prompt: Small lime-green wrapped Halloween sweet with pointed twist wrappers and purple centre, x0..16 y4..12 z4..12. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
